newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Svyazinvest won't be auctioned this week.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Svyazinvest won't be auctioned this week.

text.p: Russia has not finalised terms for the sale of a 25 percent plus one share stake in telecoms holding company Svyazinvest, and will not formally announce the auction this week, a privatisation official said on Tuesday.
"The auction will not be this week," Russian Federal Property Fund spokesman Vladimir Yefimchik told Reuters. "The conditions for it have still not been completely worked out."
A spokesman for privatisation minister Alfred Kokh last week said the auction, which will be open to foreigners, would probably be announced this week.
Deputy Prime Minister Vladimir Bulgak told Reuters on Monday that he understood the conditions had been finalised and Russia would soon begin accepting bids for a period of about one month.

Presidential and governmental orders have set general terms for the sale of the stake, which is large enough to block changes to the charter of Svyazinvest, including a starting price of $1.18 billion.
Analysts say Svyazinvest, which has controlling stakes in 89 regional telecoms and other telecoms, including long-distance carrier Rostelekom RTKM.RTS, is a key to the domestic telecoms industry.
